source.author: verg
source.text: Dixit; sed caeca Menoetes saxa timens proram pelagi detorquet ad undas.
source.text_original: Dixit; sed caeca Menoetes / saxa timens proram pelagi detorquet ad undas.
source.text_english: He spoke; but blind Menoetes, fearing the hidden rocks, turns the prow of the sea toward the waves.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Dixit et Haemonias oculos detorquet ad undas.
reuse.text_original: ' / Dixit et Haemonias oculos detorquet ad undas.
reuse.text_english: He spoke and turned his Haemonian eyes to the waves.
